errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart with 4 main groups on the x-axis (Fluency, Coherence, Consistency, Relevance). Each of these groups contains 8 bars, one for each model. The description incorrectly states that there are 8 groups, one for each model.
In the 'Fluency' category, the lowest score belongs to Llama2-7b (light green bar, approximately 8.8), not ChatGLM3-6b (light blue bar, approximately 8.9).
In the 'Coherence' category, the highest score belongs to GPT3.5-turbo-COT (dark orange bar, approximately 9.2), not QWen1.5-7b-COT (dark red bar, approximately 8.8).
Following the incorrect identification of the highest score in 'Coherence', the value is also stated incorrectly. The highest score (for GPT3.5-turbo-COT) is approximately 9.2, not 8.7.
In the 'Coherence' category, the lowest score (for ChatGLM3-6b) is approximately 8.3, as it is clearly above the 8.0 grid line. The stated value of 7.9 is incorrect.
In the 'Consistency' category, the lowest score belongs to ChatGLM3-6b (light blue bar, approximately 8.3), not QWen1.5-7b (light red bar, approximately 8.9).
While GPT3.5-turbo-COT does have the highest score in 'Relevance', its value is approximately 9.4, not 8.7.
In the 'Relevance' category, the lowest score (for ChatGLM3-6b) is approximately 8.1, as the bar is visibly above the 8.0 grid line. The stated value of 7.8 is incorrect.
The description omits the text 'Ignore 1-5' located in the bottom left corner of the chart area.
